game: LA @ BAL Week 6 2025, kickoff 2025-10-12 13:00 ET, outdoor, BAL +7, total 43.5

script.base: LA is the -7 favorite (implied 25.2 to BAL 18.2) with Lamar Jackson already Out, so the Rams should lead by halftime in a low-40s outdoor game and close on the ground with Kyren Williams (47 carries, 236 yards in weeks 3-5). Baltimore's unnamed backup is capped, the 7-point dog throws more in theory, and Henry's rush efficiency stays poor against a Rams front allowing 3.56 YPC.
script.flip1: Baltimore stays competitive by making Henry the whole offense (only 35 carries for 125 yards over weeks 3-5, but no Lamar read-option and a backup who cannot throw) and LA never gets the late clock-killing script, so Kyren's carry total stalls and Henry clears 42.5 on volume.
script.flip2: LA jumps out big, Kyren's late snaps get cut for Blake Corum (18 carries, 87 yards in the same three games) and Stafford/Nacua/Adams yardage stalls, while Henry is abandoned once the deficit grows.

injury_fallout: Official pre-game nflverse report, inactives ~90 minutes before kick not in the pack. BAL Out: QB Lamar Jackson (hamstring) removes 13 carries/83 rush yards from weeks 3-5 and the read-option that lightens Henry's box; FB Patrick Ricard (calf) and T Emery Jones Jr. (shoulder) weaken Henry's run blocking; LB Roquan Smith (hamstring) and CB Chidobe Awuzie (hamstring) are the defensive losses, so Kyren faces an unlisted backup LB and Nacua/Adams face an unlisted backup CB; WR Devontez Walker (oblique) Out. BAL WR Zay Flowers is Questionable (shoulder) — his 74.5 recyds stand-in is a season median while weeks 3-5 were only 159 yards on 16 targets, but he is not a leg (Q tag, Walker out can concentrate targets, LA allows 8.04 YPA to the left). LA T Rob Havenstein Doubtful (ankle): if he sits, rush efficiency down and quick throws up. LA LB Omar Speights Doubtful (ankle) is a mild counter to any BAL RB under. LA TE Colby Parkinson and WR Tutu Atwell Questionable; no replacement snap shares are in the pack.

matchup.shell: No coverage charting in the pack, so MOFO/MOFC and man/zone are unknown.
matchup.pressure: BAL blitzes 32%; LA EPA/db is -0.06 when blitzed vs 0.31 when not, so pressure that gets home pushes Stafford to check-downs (Kyren had 17 targets, only 31 air yards in weeks 3-5) and hurts deep WR yards. LA blitzes 29%; BAL EPA/db is 0.14 vs blitz and 0.09 vs none, a small edge either way that does not rescue a Lamar-less offense.
matchup.bleeds: BAL run defense allows 5.02 YPC and 13 runs of 10+ in five games, and 8.72 YPA in the middle (40 attempts) vs 7.26 left and 6.21 right. LA run defense allows 3.56 YPC and only 10 runs of 10+, but 8.04 YPA to the left (79 attempts) vs 7.09 middle and 5.34 right, plus 13 passes of 20+ for 188 yards.
matchup.overlap: Kyren is the overlap: lead back at 5.0 YPC (236/47) into a 5.02 YPC defense missing Roquan Smith, in a favorite script. Nacua (42 targets, 367 yards, 424 air yards in three games) overlaps the soft middle and Awuzie absence, but that is partly cancelled by LA's negative EPA vs the blitz and is not a leg. Henry has the inverse overlap: a 3.57 YPC back into a 3.56 YPC defense.

Corum rush last4 44, 53, 21, 13, share fading. Nacua rec last4 91, 112, 170, 85 with weeks 3-5 at 367 yards, so the 170 is the explosive outlier. Adams last4 106, 56, 56, 88. Henry rush last4 23, 50, 42, 33 (3 of 4 under 42.5; L3 125 yards, 3.57 YPC) and rec last4 0, 7, 16, 0. Hill rush last4 7, 0, 76, 3 is one-play inflated. Flowers last4 75, 13, 74, 72 vs a 74.5 median stand-in, but weeks 3-5 total only 159 yards. No similar-defense game logs beyond these splits.

data_check.notes: Step 8 is incomplete: no projection, no sims, no Pinnacle no-vig. model_p values are hand rates from the pack, not sims, and both are kept under 70% on purpose. Kyren L3 mean 78.7 agrees with over 66.5; last4 binary is 2/4, so a strict lean-disagreement rule could drop him — flagged, not cut, because the misses are 65 and 66 and the matchup read is the edge. pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost because Havenstein sat, Baltimore sold out against the run with Smith's replacement, and Kyren finished in the mid-50s while Corum took the fourth quarter. Henry got 18-20 carries because the unnamed backup could not throw, ripped one chunk run at a Speights-less front, and cleared 42.5 at a bad YPC. The 43.5 turned into a grimy Baltimore rock fight instead of an LA lead, which is flip1, and that counter is why both legs stay leans rather than strong.
slip_story: One script only: LA controls a sub-44 outdoor game with Lamar out. Favorite clock stack — Kyren rush over into a 5.02 YPC defense missing Roquan, Henry rush under into a 3.56 YPC defense with his FB and tackle out. Do not add BAL pass overs, a total over, or Corum over, which needs the blowout flip.
